no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting is required. The review team determined early in the application review cycle that this new product for glabellar lines presented no novel or complex regulatory issues that required the input of an advisory committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for JEUVEAU (BLA761085). The multidisciplinary review team determined early in the review cycle that this product for glabellar lines presented no novel or complex regulatory issues warranting advisory committee input. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
